messages.subject: Disconnected from the server when deployed. (no error when running local)
parts:
Hi All,
I am new to ShinyServer but have an app that Take MP3 files, does some processing, and then displays a table with some info about that MP3. When I run the ShinyApp on my local machine it works great. Then when I try to deploy to ShinyApps.IO or event AWS Shiny Server, it does soon after uploading the file. I cannot figure out what the issue is. Any help is appreciated.

Link to App: https://vclip.shinyapps.io/vclipbasic/

Sample Mp3, Log file and Source Files are attached.

I am wondering if these are because of memory issues.

Emad

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Disconnected from the server when deployed. (no error when running local)
parts: I suspect that the default instance size isn't big enough to accommodate larger MP3 files.   If you haven't already, I would suggest trying a larger instance size.  We definitely want to give you more information for when memory runs out, it is unfortunately impossible to figure out today.
